_comment: Quarter-turn -> explicatio combo (drill mode -- player army only, no enemy, no auto-win): one Infantry regiment staged as a marching COLUMN, 5 files wide and 8 ranks deep, facing south. Select it and press Shift+Q: the men quarter-turn LEFT in place (the block now faces east and presents its long side, 8 across and 5 deep, as its front), and the instant the turn completes the explicatio fires against that NEW facing -- the rear half of each file steps out sideways, so the block unfolds into a 16-wide, 3-deep line across the direction it now faces. One gesture chains the two drills that deploying a column into line historically combined. The far files walk about 135 wu to reach the line's ends, so the unfold takes ~7 s to settle; the regiment's anchor point settles about a metre during it (the same coupling settle a plain explicatio shows, larger here because the re-lay-out is) and is then dead still. Sampling note: the state ticks sit off two brief mid-transit moments (around ticks 180 and 420) where a passing pair of bodies dips under the defect scan's overlap floor for a few ticks -- a property of any reshape walk (the same column given a plain B explicatio dips under it at six sampled ticks), not of the combo. Infantry carry directional pointer marks that rotate to show the facing at this zoom (mark LOD). Re-pinned 2026-11-14 for the combo widen as the explicatio drill: the widen used to double 8 files against the 5 the column had before the turn, which is no doubling, so it was dealt laterally about the centre and the front fell back from x 556.0 to 521.8, the block settling at [503.79, 385.76]; now it doubles the 8 files the turned block stands on as the drill, each man following a man he can see, the front holds at x 556.0 and the block settles at [537.94, 400.0] by tick 480. The hash stream first differs at tick 57 on seed runs 0 to 4 (cheap tier); the frontage and facing expects hold either way. Driven live through the real SelectionManager by tools/demo/DemoInputRecorder.gd; world coordinates; physics ticks (60/s).

overlap.reason: Rear half-files step out laterally during the explicatio unfold; passing bodies transiently dip to 1.6-1.9 wu mid-transit before settling.
